_comment: MIDDLE-EXIT = ATR STOP calibration. Forces UseATRStop=1, swapping the RSIOS failed-bounce middle exit for a hard ATR stop at PurchasePrice - StopATRMult×EntryATR. NOTE: EUTR's staged walk-forward kept UseATRStop=0, so run this only to re-test that conclusion if the screen surprises you. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker EUTR -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/eutr/reversion_cal_atrstop.json -out ./reports/EUTR_atrstop -months 31 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
